name: code_review
description: Review code: naming, comment coverage, long functions (>50 lines), duplicated blocks, diff review. No LLM, deterministic regex. Pass file or source; use diff for SEARCH/REPLACE patch review.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: project root (abs). reindex first if new.

file.description: File path relative to workspace_dir to review (reads from disk)

source.description: Source code text to review (mutually exclusive with file)

diff.description: Patch to review block-by-block: SEARCH/REPLACE (<<<<<<< SEARCH ... ======= ... >>>>>>> REPLACE) or unified diff (--- a/x.js / +++ b/x.js / @@ hunks)
